_note: Every line is synthesised by Gnani Timbre v2.5 (gen_voice.py). 'say' is what Timbre reads; 'caption' is what the video shows.

lines.say: I am M two zero four. A hydraulic press motor, in a factory in Hyderabad.
lines.caption: I am M-204. A hydraulic press motor, in a factory in Hyderabad.

lines.say: This morning, my bearing began to shake. I felt it first. But I cannot speak.
lines.caption: This morning, my bearing began to shake. I felt it first. But I cannot speak.

lines.say: Ravi can. He is the technician standing next to me. Until today, his report was a phone call, a WhatsApp message, or a line in a paper log.
lines.caption: Ravi can. Until today, his report was a phone call, a WhatsApp message, or a line in a paper log.

lines.say: Half the details got lost. And the supervisor heard about me too late.
lines.caption: Half the details got lost. And the supervisor heard about me too late.

lines.say: This, is Kaam Setu. A bridge, from spoken work, to structured action.
lines.caption: This is KAAMSETU. A bridge from spoken work to structured action.

lines.say: Ravi taps the mic, and talks the way he really talks. In Hinglish.
lines.caption: Ravi taps the mic and talks the way he really talks. In Hinglish.

lines.say: मोटर का प्रेशर एबनॉर्मल है। बेयरिंग में वाइब्रेशन आ रहा है। मशीन नंबर एम टू ज़ीरो फोर है। प्रोडक्शन अभी चल रहा है।
lines.caption: Motor ka pressure abnormal hai. Bearing mein vibration aa raha hai. Machine number M-204 hai. Production abhi chal raha hai.

lines.say: Gyaani Prisma turns his speech into text. Then plain, deterministic rules, with no language model guessing, pull out the machine, the symptoms, and the priority.
lines.caption: Gnani Prisma turns his speech into text. Then deterministic rules, with no language model guessing, pull out the machine, the symptoms and the priority.

lines.say: Less than three seconds later, Gyaani Timbre reads it back to him.
lines.caption: Less than three seconds later, Gnani Timbre reads it back to him.

lines.say: M-204 ke liye maintenance request taiyaar hai. Priority high hai. Check karke submit kijiye.
lines.caption: M-204 ke liye maintenance request taiyaar hai. Priority high hai. Check karke submit kijiye.

lines.say: One tap. Work order ten forty seven is born.
lines.caption: One tap. Work order WO-1047 is born.

lines.say: On the supervisor's console, Priya sees it within seconds. Ravi's exact words, kept as evidence, right next to the structured order. She approves it, and assigns Lakshmi.
lines.caption: On the supervisor's console, Priya sees it within seconds. Ravi's exact words, kept as evidence, next to the structured order. She approves it and assigns Lakshmi.

lines.say: Lakshmi speaks Telugu. So her task speaks Telugu.
lines.caption: Lakshmi speaks Telugu. So her task speaks Telugu.

lines.say: M-204 పై కొత్త పని WO-1047 మీకు కేటాయించబడింది. ప్రాధాన్యత అధిక.
lines.caption: M-204 పై కొత్త పని WO-1047 మీకు కేటాయించబడింది. ప్రాధాన్యత అధిక.

lines.say: She follows the safety checklist, step by step. The app will not let her finish, until every mandatory step is done.
lines.caption: She follows the safety checklist, step by step. The app will not let her finish until every mandatory step is done.

lines.say: Priya closes the order. Every step, every name, every minute, is in the audit trail.
lines.caption: Priya closes the order. Every step, every name, every minute is in the audit trail.

lines.say: So, who is this for? Technicians, who would rather speak than type. Supervisors, who need to see the whole floor. And factories, that cannot afford a lost report.
lines.caption: Who is this for? Technicians who would rather speak than type. Supervisors who need to see the whole floor. Factories that cannot afford a lost report.

lines.say: Two Gyaani models make it work. Prisma version three, for speech to text, in Hindi, Telugu, English and Hinglish. And Timbre version two point five, to answer every technician in their own language.
lines.caption: Two Gnani models make it work. Prisma v3.0 for speech to text in Hindi, Telugu, English and Hinglish. Timbre v2.5 to answer every technician in their own language.

lines.say: And when a service goes down, the app says so, and lets him type instead. It never fakes a result. We broke it on purpose, twelve different ways, to be sure.
lines.caption: When a service goes down, the app says so and lets him type instead. It never fakes a result. We broke it on purpose, twelve different ways, to be sure.

lines.say: One last thing. I am a motor. I do not have a voice.
lines.caption: One last thing. I am a motor. I do not have a voice.

lines.say: The one you have been listening to, was generated by Gyaani Timbre.
lines.caption: The one you have been listening to was generated by Gnani Timbre.

lines.say: Kaam Setu. Speak the work. Structure the action. Keep operations moving.
lines.caption: KAAMSETU. Speak the work. Structure the action. Keep operations moving.
